tiktok.caption: Harvard proved the 'wrong' debt payoff method beats perfect math — snowball users pay off 14% more debt. Here's why.

youtube_short.title: Harvard Proved 'Wrong' Debt Payoff Beats Perfect
title_alternatives: The Debt Trick That Outperforms Perfect Math
Why Your Smart Debt Plan Makes You Quit
youtube_short.description: The debt avalanche is mathematically perfect — attack the highest APR first and you save the most in interest. So why do snowball users pay off 14% more debt? Harvard researchers tracked real people paying down real balances and found the answer: emotional momentum beats a spreadsheet every time. When a big-balance card barely moves month after month, most people quit. But knocking out a small balance fast keeps you in the fight. Pick the card you can kill in 90 days and start there. Follow for daily money traps nobody explains. #personalfinance #debtfree #debtpayoff #moneytips #financialfreedom

hook_line: Paying off debt 'wrong' beats perfect math
